thread:
elaine: Quick announcement: rolling out Hosted API Stream Adapter + ToolCall v3 to all hosted accounts next Tues. Initial window is opt-in for 48h, then we flip to on by default if metrics look good. :confetti_ball:

release-bot: Release deployed: stream-adapter@v1.2 -> prod-regions (canary 4h, 3 regions).

tom: Does this break older tool schemas?

elaine: No. Adapter negotiates versions; v3 is preferred but v1/v2 fallbacks remain for 9 months.

support-team: Heads-up for CS: no billing changes, recommend customers test in staging. We'll provide a playbook.

docs: Draft migration snippet (curl): 
```bash
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" 
  -H \"X-RW-Tool-Version: 3\" 
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite","stream":true,"input":"summarize:..."}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-adapter
```

tom: Any perf wins?

elaine: Yes — streaming coalescing + prefix caching for tools. Expect ~5-12% token cost reduction on tool-heavy flows and lower p95 for short responses.

support-team: Creating CS playbook and canned responses.

docs: Node & Python SDK patches (v0.9.6) with header opt-in and concurrency bump to 12 shipping today. Go/Java next week.

elaine: Monitoring: new dashboard \"StreamAdapter / ToolCall v3\" and SLO 99.9% success. If you see regressions, tag @support-team with request ids.

tom: Thanks — I'll run multi-region E2E tests and post results here.

elaine: Thanks all. We'll announce broadly once opt-in window closes if metrics are stable. :rocket:
